task: verify an uploaded skill works in the product

families.label: Give Claude a matching task and confirm the skill loads

variants.label: Enable in Customize > Skills, prompt, read Claude's thinking, iterate the description
preconditions: the skill has been uploaded to the account
steps: Enable the skill in Customize > Skills
Try prompts that should trigger it
Review Claude's thinking to confirm it is loading the skill
Iterate on the description if Claude is not using it when expected

variants.label: Check a plugin-delivered skill on a member device after the admin upload
preconditions: the skill is packaged in a plugin and added on the admin portal Plugins card
if the admin chose Members choose, the plugin must be installed on the device first
steps: Open Claude Desktop as a member
Install the plugin if you chose Members choose
Give Claude a task the skill should match
To change the skill later, update the plugin

sources.anchor: ## Building and deploying your own skills

claude.note: self-uploaded skill: the user enables it in Customize > Skills, then prompts and inspects Claude's thinking

claude-gov.note: admin verifies a plugin-delivered skill on a device; the upload checks packaging, not skill content, so a malformed SKILL.md only shows up here

checked: skills--how-to ### After uploading (read with the surrounding ## Testing your skill and ## Packaging your skill sections)
government--desktop--skills ## Building and deploying your own skills (Check it on a device paragraph in full, plus ## Create and manage skills and ## Skills for administrators)
summary: Both documented cells confirm a skill by prompting Claude, but differ in actor, enabling gate, and how the skill reached the account.
open_questions: The claude-gov record is tagged actor admin while its steps say to open Claude Desktop 'as a member'; the text does not say whether the admin verifies on their own device or asks a member, so P1b may be a two-actor path.

Whether P1a's first step (enable in Customize > Skills) belongs to T-042 rather than here could not be settled from the source; it was kept because it opens the same numbered list that ends in a confirmed trigger.

No records for claude-web, claude-desktop, claude-desktop-3p, claude-tag, or cowork; the reads could not distinguish pages that genuinely omit a verification step from units absent in the pilot corpus.
